pages.text: The river fell, revealing a stone bridge. The water did not even reach their ankles. A big tree stood across it.
Mina wanted to reach its shade. "Raju, let's go just the two of us."
Sonu walked slowly. Mina got shoes ready without Sonu noticing.
Mina and Raju went out. Sonu followed. "Me, too!"
Mina shut the door in front of Sonu. "Stay home."
Sonu sat on the threshold and sobbed.
Crying filled the yard. Mom stood at the door.
Mom asked Mina, "How about holding Sonu's hand and walking slowly? You want to go to the shade together, too, don't you?"
Mina crouched before Sonu and put shoes on the little feet.
Holding hands, all three entered the tree's shade. Mina's hands linked Raju and Sonu. Three shadows overlapped into one.
